title: 第二十一章 李云岫心里不舒服第二十二章 千柳庄婚宴
content_zh:
三个江湖汉子吐血晕倒，并没有引起什么波澜。
摆明了的江湖恩怨，苦主无人，朝廷不管，围观群众自然也不会多事。
店家继续上菜，客人继续碰杯，只不过大家的议论都不自觉的小声了些，也没有再涉及镇西王府和江湖上的著名高手。
……
返回镇西王府，王昱将芊芊送回鸿雁阁，送了她一瓶薰衣草的香水，然后就拿着一瓶郁金香香水来到了王府后殿。
镇西王府分为前后两殿，前殿作为正式的见客之所，也负责接待宾客举办宴会，后殿则是王府处理政务的所在。
李云岫如今就在后殿办公。
“你今天和芊芊出门了？”李云岫问道。
“这么快就在府里安插内线了？”王昱挑眉问道。
说到这个话题，李云岫就有些苦恼，“是紫菱去找你，我才知道的，也不知道那个芊芊究竟给府中下人灌了什么迷魂汤，那些仆役丫鬟一个个都向着她。”
王昱看看李云岫有些慑人的气魄，又想想芊芊的温柔软糯，非常理解的点点头。
“你那是什么眼神？”李云岫当然也知道这一点，只不过她要执掌府中事务，就不能走芊芊那条路线。
恩威并施，方为正道！
“我来给你送香水，西域刚出的新物件，带在身上随时滴两滴，能持续一个时辰的香味。”王昱将一瓶郁金香香水放到李云岫案头。
李云岫拿起金属小瓶，给自己衣袖上滴了两滴，一股浓郁的芬芳顿时弥漫开来。
“比香囊浓郁，多谢你了。”李云岫深深的吸了一口气，问王昱道，“那个芊芊究竟是什么来头，赵峥还有这种老朋友？”
“不知道。”王昱摇头。
“那她姓什么？”李云岫再问，知道了姓氏，就能查到她的家世和底细了。
“不知道。”王昱再摇头。
李云岫眼神一眯，“那你知道什么？”

王昱露出笑容，“我知道她真好看。”
李云岫咬牙，“男人没一个好东西，当了王爷就饱暖思淫欲了。”
王昱无奈说道，“我是一个正常的男人，你不给我，还拦着不让我找别人？想要掌控镇西王府的是皇帝和你，不是我，想要马儿跑，总得让马儿吃点草吧。”
李云岫都无语了，继承镇西王位，还不算让马儿吃草？
但看着王昱除了练武之外就是整日和芊芊腻在一起，李云岫心中也莫名有些不舒服。
按理来说，她对王昱是完全没有男女私情的，只是对皇帝尽忠，也希望天下太平，王昱对她来说就是个合作的陌生人，两人只是名义上的夫妻。
但一路行来，王昱几次临危发力，智取黑衣人，言动方少白，无论说剑还是说酒，都自有一种从容不迫的气度，令人另眼相看。
回到镇西王府，虽然王昱并没有模仿出赵昱性格乖张、嚣张跋扈的样子，但却临危不乱，演绎出一种智珠在握、霸道果决的性格。
不说他在得知赵峥死于先帝之手后说服赵嵘继续用自己做事，只说他第二日在会客堂震慑王府悍将，缴了赵思齐的兵权一事，即便是李云岫知道后也不得不道一声佩服。
当时才是他到王府的第二天啊！
他离开王府已经十年，正常人在这种情况下都不会和一个爷爷辈并且还是一军统帅甚至是镇西王府资历最老的老将正面硬刚。
content_en:
The three gangsters vomited blood and fainted, but it didn't cause any trouble.
The grievances and grievances in the world have been made clear, and no one is responsible for the suffering. The court does not care, and the onlookers will naturally not be troublesome.
The store continued to serve food, and the guests continued to clink glasses, but everyone's discussions unconsciously became quieter, and they no longer involved the Zhenxi Prince's Palace and the famous masters in the world.
…
Returning to Zhenxi Palace, Wang Yu sent Qianqian back to Hongyan Pavilion, gave her a bottle of lavender perfume, and then took a bottle of tulip perfume to the back hall of the palace.
The Zhenxi Palace is divided into two halls, the front and rear. The front hall serves as a formal place to meet guests and is also responsible for receiving guests and holding banquets. The back hall is where the palace handles government affairs.
Li Yunxiu is now working in the back hall.
"Did you go out with Qianqian today?" Li Yunxiu asked.
"A spy was installed in the mansion so quickly?" Wang Yu asked with raised eyebrows.
When it came to this topic, Li Yunxiu felt a little troubled, "I didn't know until Ziling came to find you. I don't know what kind of ecstasy soup that Qianqian poured into the servants in the mansion. All the servants and maids turned to her."
Wang Yu looked at Li Yunxiu's awe-inspiring aura, and thought about Qianqian's tenderness and softness, and nodded with great understanding.
"What's that look in your eyes?" Of course Li Yunxiu also knew this, but if she wanted to take charge of the affairs of the house, she couldn't take Qianqian's route.
Applying both grace and power is the right way!
"I'm here to give you perfume. It's a new item just released from the Western Regions. You can put two drops on it at any time. The fragrance will last for an hour." Wang Yu put a bottle of tulip perfume on Li Yunxiu's desk.
Li Yunxiu picked up the small metal bottle and put two drops on his sleeve, and a rich fragrance suddenly filled the air.
"It's richer than a sachet. Thank you very much." Li Yunxiu took a deep breath and asked Wang Yu, "What is the origin of that Qianqian? Does Zhao Zheng have such an old friend?"
"I don't know." Wang Yu shook his head.
"Then what's her last name?" Li Yunxiu asked again. Knowing her last name, she could find out her family background and details.
"I don't know." Wang Yu shook his head again.
Li Yunxiu narrowed his eyes, "Then what do you know?"
Wang Yu smiled and said, "I know she is so beautiful."
Li Yunxiu gritted his teeth, "No man is good. Once you become a prince, you will be full and warm and lustful."
Wang Yu said helplessly, "I am a normal man, and you don't give it to me, but you also prevent me from finding someone else? It is the emperor and you who want to control the Zhenxi Palace, not me. If you want the horse to run, you have to let the horse eat some grass."
Li Yunxiu was speechless. If he inherited the throne of Zhenxi, wouldn't he let the horses eat grass?
But seeing Wang Yu spending all day with Qian Qian Ni besides practicing martial arts, Li Yunxiu felt inexplicably uncomfortable.
Logically speaking, she had no personal relationship with Wang Yu at all. She was just loyal to the emperor and hoped for peace in the world. Wang Yu was a cooperative stranger to her, and the two were husband and wife in name only.
But along the way, Wang Yu used his strength several times in times of danger to outsmart the man in black. Fang Shaobai's words and actions, whether talking about swords or wine, had a calm and unhurried demeanor that made people admire him.
Returning to Zhenxi Palace, although Wang Yu did not imitate Zhao Yu's arrogant and domineering character, he remained calm in the face of danger and demonstrated a wise, domineering and decisive character.
Not to mention that he persuaded Zhao Rong to continue using himself after learning that Zhao Zheng died at the hands of the late emperor, but that he shocked the royal generals in the guest hall the next day and surrendered Zhao Siqi's military power. Even Li Yunxiu had to admire him after knowing it.
It was only the second day after he arrived at the palace!
It has been ten years since he left the palace. Under such circumstances, no normal person would confront a grandfather who is also the commander of an army or even the most senior veteran of Zhenxi Palace.
